gap_leg_crossed=true for episodes whose forward window crosses 2021-10-25..2025-01-02

items.thesis_one_liner: Affirm's deeply compressed rebound failed when rapid GMV growth could not offset credit normalization, funding sensitivity and negative operating economics.
Positive HELIOS-B data re-underwrote vutrisiran as a credible ATTR-CM expansion asset and reset Alnylam's RNAi franchise path.

ALT's intranasal-platform probability re-rating failed because preclinical differentiation, financing access, and government-adjacent optionality were capitalized before human immunogenicity and competitive timing could support them.
Record operating leverage, foundry/logic and memory product breadth, and a customer-verified wafer-fab-equipment capex upswing turned AMAT's late-2020 recovery into a durable relative breakaway.
AMD escaped a loss model as AMD64 architecture and OEM/software adoption combined with flash recovery, a lower break-even level, and sequential execution to produce a return to profitability.
A Q3 sequential revenue acceleration, resilient margins, and a credible 2021 cloud/400G recovery reset trough expectations while enterprise software and security products widened the runway.
Repeated AI/datacom organic-growth proof, margin expansion, and an enlarging acquisition runway caused APH's earnings duration to be re-underwritten faster than XLK during 2025.

APLD's AI-infrastructure re-rating failed because an unsigned hyperscaler lease and conditional, equity-linked financing could not support a 63-day breakaway once a new ATM exposed continuing share-supply dependence.
AppLovin rerated after Q3 2024 showed AXON-driven growth converting into high-margin earnings power.
AST SpaceMobile rerated after carrier-backed agreements and satellite-launch milestones moved the story from concept toward commercial deployment.
ATI's alpha came from converting aerospace capacity investment into margin expansion and contract-backed utilization, with index flow and research catch-up acting as accelerants.

VMware cash conversion and a progressively de-risked custom-AI-plus-networking runway drove repeated re-underwriting, while December margin-mix concerns ended the short-term relative advance without erasing full-year alpha.

X26-led adoption, expanding margins and self-funded capacity created real earnings re-underwriting, while low float, heavy short positioning and split reflexivity made the terminal advance far less durable than the business improvement.
Axon rerated as repeated beat-and-raise quarters showed that recurring cloud, AI and connected public-safety products could compound alongside the hardware franchise.

A genuine communications-demand acceleration was amplified by scarce post-offering float and a photonic-product vertical, then failed when the move met a five-times-float HP distribution, inconsistent margin conversion, and the technology-cycle reversal.

A damaged cyclical conglomerate became a durable winner when a measurable cost reset and recovering semiconductor-test demand converted sequential losses into reported profit and free cash flow, while the initial tape moved before the earnings model caught up.

Boeing's alpha came from re-underwriting a strike- and safety-depressed base as production, backlog, liquidity and cash conversion improved, but it faded when 777X duration risk showed the turnaround was not yet economically smooth.
BITB's large 2024 alpha versus SPY came from bitcoin access, scarcity, liquidity, and election-policy repricing, while near-zero relative return versus IBIT shows little wrapper-specific alpha.
Dutch Bros rerated when transaction recovery, mobile ordering, improving site selection, rapid unit growth, and operating leverage made the expansion model more credible.
CAVA rerated when traffic-led same-store growth, rapid unit expansion, near-25% restaurant margins, and corporate profitability accumulated into proof of a portable fast-casual model.

Contract-price resilience and a sequence of policy and Westinghouse earnings catalysts re-underwrote Cameco from uranium miner to scarce integrated nuclear-fuel-and-reactor platform, producing durable index alpha but not proven full-year sector alpha.
Tighter crop balances, improving nitrogen economics, clean-ammonia optionality, and an analyst model reset repriced CF from a depressed cyclical prior.

European gas-driven nitrogen curtailments repriced global fertilizer to the marginal cost while CF's predominantly North American production retained a feedstock advantage, converting scarcity into a multi-quarter margin and cash-flow rerating.
Election-driven bitcoin beta and data-center optionality produced a liquid relative breakaway, but weak current mining economics and capital dependence prevented durable follow-through.

Real low-base microgrid growth and policy optionality drew liquidity, but a capital raise and late bitcoin-mining identity change turned the episode into a reflexive two-stage blow-off rather than a durable hold.
CrowdStrike rerated as accelerating net-new ARR, multi-module platform adoption, GAAP profit, and free-cash-flow scale changed the market's estimate of durable security-platform economics.
Carvana rerated from distressed survival risk after operating improvement and a July debt-exchange agreement changed near-term liquidity math.
Duolingo rerated as product-led engagement, paid conversion, AI-enabled Max monetization, and operating leverage compounded without breaking the free-user growth engine.

Repeated proof that K-12 demand, O2O retention, and facility utilization could produce revenue growth plus operating leverage drove a cash-funded platform rerating, although TAL leadership and October margin pressure show material cohort beta.
Repeated public proof that rapid K-12 and facility growth could mature into expanding operating margins turned a regulation-and-margin discount into a year-long rerating.
Repeated earnings, margin, RPO, and guidance resets forced a durable re-underwriting of EMCOR faster than its Industrials cohort and the broad index.

Brazilian equities rerated from a macro and policy washout as impeachment raised the probability of an orthodox government, while a gentler Fed, firmer commodities, and a sharply stronger real compounded the dollar return.

FCX sustained alpha because vaccine/China-driven copper repricing coincided with a company-specific Grasberg volume ramp, falling unit costs, expanding cash flow and later balance-sheet/cash-allocation proof.

Fabrinet was re-rated from a low-margin manufacturer with a datacom air pocket into a scarce optical-capacity beneficiary as telecom resilience and 800G, 1.6T, Blackwell and HPC ramps became reported growth.
Enacted U.S. manufacturing incentives transformed the economics of a cash-rich, capacity-constrained module producer with a record multi-year backlog.
FUTU re-rated when proven brokerage-platform operating leverage met a sudden China capital-market policy shock, then the first vertical leg faded as fiscal follow-through disappointed.

A global rate-path and safe-haven repricing lifted gold while miner cost cuts, cash conversion, and deleveraging amplified the bullion move into equity returns, but later GDXJ outperformance and the post-August reversal show cycle beta rather than durable GDX-specific alpha.

A real high-growth telehealth platform was repriced through a recent-SPAC, ARK-attention, and research-vacuum loop before operating results could anchor valuation, so liquidity clustered near the top and later fundamental improvement could not preserve the breakaway.
Hims' delayed June signal failed on the 63-session hold because it arrived after the GLP-1 shock without fresh liquidity, even though a later Q3 acceleration launched a separate resurrection.
Robinhood rerated as profitable account growth broadened into international crypto, tokenized assets and institutional infrastructure, with later S&P 500 inclusion amplifying liquidity.

Higher-rate earnings, monetized surplus capital, China reopening, and increasingly explicit distributions turned a discounted global bank into an observable cash-return story, but most alpha formed before the mechanical onset.

Solexa sequencing shifted from acquisition promise to measurable scientific and commercial adoption, forcing serial revenue re-underwriting while Illumina's array franchise and cash generation funded the platform scale-up.

The dual HiSeq X Ten and NextSeq launch widened sequencing economics at both factory and desktop scale, while regulated diagnostics and serial execution converted product promise into recurring platform growth.

Illumina's post-washout 2025 breakaway became durable when cost-led margin and cash-flow repair broadened into multiomics products, ex-China stabilization and partial China relief, although one Q3 session created most final sector alpha.

A capacity-and-AI re-underwriting produced exceptional late-2023 alpha, but the breakaway failed because t0 capped an already vertical, equity-funded miner cycle before contracted AI revenue or sustained mining economics could support the new price level.

IREN rerated from a profitable Bitcoin miner into a power-rich AI cloud platform as GPU procurement became financed, contracted and finally hyperscaler-backed, before capital intensity and dilution broke the vertical move.

Procedure-linked recurring revenue stayed resilient through a hospital-capex recession, while the da Vinci Si refresh converted that usage strength into a platform rerating that persisted beyond the Q2 expectations shock.

LDOS rerated as flat revenue gave way to accelerating organic growth, higher margins, stronger cash conversion, expanding backlog, and repeated guidance increases, with index inclusion amplifying but not causing the move.

Policy made domestic enrichment a strategic bottleneck, and successive earnings, DOE, production, and customer-financing evidence re-priced Centrus from lumpy fuel reseller toward scarce U.S. producer before expectations outran funded capacity.
A loss-making optical supplier rerated into an AI-connectivity bottleneck as named ecosystem roles and hyperscaler products converted into repeated revenue acceleration and extreme margin repair.

Repeated financing, construction, and 20-year capacity-contract milestones converted Cheniere's future liquefaction cash flows from a speculative proposal into an increasingly funded and contracted infrastructure asset.

Flight proof, funded NASA awards, and a communications-platform re-rating produced genuine alpha, but IDIQ ceilings, financing-driven runway, unstable margins, late-cycle liquidity, and a second sideways landing could not sustain the valuation.

A Bitcoin-cycle upswing became company-specific alpha when fixed-price miner orders, low-cost power, and reflexive equity financing transformed a subscale loss-maker into a prospective 10.36 EH/s miner and direct Bitcoin proxy.

A recapitalized miner became a high-beta listed Bitcoin proxy and was priced on future fleet capacity, but the March onset arrived after a vertical move and failed when turnover turned distributive, Bitcoin reversed, and current cash earnings could not anchor the valuation.

A deeply compressed Bitcoin proxy rerated on restored hosting, miner energization, and macro risk appetite, but future hash-rate promises could not survive negative mining economics, Bitcoin-secured liquidity, host failure, and a renewed crypto shock.

A Bitcoin and spot-ETF cycle upswing became MARA-specific alpha when rapid hash-rate execution, deleveraging, and the first owned-site acquisition expanded production and lowered future cost assumptions faster than published models could adjust.

MP rerated from a private customer-concentrated mine into a liquid, funded U.S. strategic-minerals vehicle when listing capital, company-specific defense support, and price-volume operating leverage made Stage II and EV optionality investable.

MP rerated from a loss-making rare-earth miner into a policy-backed integrated magnet platform when DoD contracts removed much of price, demand and funding risk and Apple added commercial proof, while the later October scarcity premium mean-reverted.
A stale, compressed COVID-decay prior was forcibly re-underwritten as a repeatable mRNA oncology/immunology platform by a ladder of public catalysts, faster than the biotech sector.
A profitable software chassis became a scarce high-beta Bitcoin treasury proxy, then used convertible debt to increase the exposure during a powerful asset cycle.

A memory-pricing upswing combined with Micron's node-cost reductions, Inotera consolidation, richer server/cloud/SSD mix, and deleveraging to create extreme operating leverage; the September 2017 earnings break produced large alpha, but the one-year XLK-relative result reversed when the market shortened cycle duration before reported fundamentals collapsed.
Pandemic compression gave way to a funded oncology-testing recovery and a commercial liquid-biopsy expansion, forcing a platform re-rating faster than XLV or SPY.
Near-50% recurring growth and large-customer expansion combined with stateful edge compute and Zero Trust networking to reframe Cloudflare as a broad internet platform.
Hefei financing removed the survival cliff just as record deliveries, positive vehicle margins, and a new battery-service model established a credible EV turnaround.

Hyperscaler nuclear commitments and NNE's dense optionality narrative drove a liquid scarcity re-rating, but no 2024 revenue, licensing, or deployment hard gate arrived before financing supply and vertical extension broke the hold.

Real semiconductor and electronics demand plus merger leverage drove a vertical re-rating, but extension, cyclical expectations, softer mix, and weak cash conversion turned confirmed liquidity into a blow-off.

Activist-enabled governance change, GenOn separation, and a quantified cost-divestiture-deleveraging plan converted NRG from a levered opaque asset collection into an underwritable cash-flow turnaround.
NRG rerated as cash-flow execution, a shrinking share count, and improving leverage made the capital-allocation framework credible just as data-center load expanded the perceived power-market runway.

Real NAS revenue acceleration and OEM distribution produced exceptional relative strength, but a non-compressed vertical entry and perfection-level expectations left the equity unable to preserve alpha through the technology-regime reversal.

A cash-rich self-developed game engine proved resilient through recession, then the three-year Blizzard license expanded the platform runway until approval risk and licensed-ramp costs reversed the clean rerating.
A real GPU-platform and Xbox re-rating became over-anticipated, peaked three sessions after the June breakaway, and failed under catalyst exhaustion and technology-multiple compression.
GeForce 6 share and mix recovery, margin leverage, and a new Sony console runway turned a damaged annual laggard into a durable relative breakaway.
Gaming cash generation plus cloud, deep-learning and automotive platform proof caused capital to re-underwrite NVIDIA from a PC-component name into a reusable accelerated-computing platform.

A three-month expectation reset broke when hyperscale data-center growth, Volta's Tensor Core product cycle, and external cloud/automotive adoption forced NVIDIA to be modeled as an accelerated-computing platform rather than a gaming-chip cycle.
A data-center AI demand guide reset forced the market to re-underwrite NVIDIA's forward revenue scale.

NXT re-rated in 2025 as earnings, backlog, guide raises, cash/no-debt runway, and platform expansion forced investors to treat it as a profitable solar infrastructure platform rather than a simple tracker supplier.
Oklo rerated as DOE fuel-facility progress, data-center demand instruments, and balance-sheet runway raised the perceived probability of future advanced-reactor commercialization.
Recurring identity growth, large-enterprise adoption, platform expansion, and improving cash conversion produced a durable software rerating.
A forecast profitability turn became an observable growth-and-margin inflection, causing OSCR to re-rate well before published targets fully caught up.
Buyer growth, rising spend per buyer, and merchant monetization overcame subsidy and loss concerns to produce a durable China-internet platform rerating.
Pinterest's delayed post-Q1 signal failed when Q2 guidance showed revenue growth decelerating toward the expense-growth rate despite healthy users and cash generation.
Palantir rerated as GAAP profitability, AI Platform demand, and index eligibility accumulated into a year-long model reset.

A pandemic-forced shift into digital commerce became a durable platform re-rating when April usage accelerated, Q2 converted usage into revenue, margin and cash flow, and new wallet products widened the runway beyond checkout.

A scientific milestone, first system-sale evidence, and equity-funded runway reset produced company-specific alpha, but the March onset was already vertical, economically under-proven, and failed before later catalysts started separate waves.

QUBT rerated on quantum-theme scarcity, foundry and Dirac-3 milestones, a NASA application contract, and a $50M financing, then failed as price outran tiny revenue and still-unproven commercialization.
Roblox's Q3 gap failed when bookings and monetization per user decelerated far faster than lagging recognized revenue implied.
Rubrik rerated as rapid subscription ARR growth, a widening cyber-resilience platform, and improving contribution economics converted a post-IPO growth story into observable cash generation.
Reddit rerated when audience growth, ad acceleration, data licensing, search product optionality, and high-gross-margin cash conversion became visible together.
Reddit rerated when AI-enabled ad products made its conversation corpus commercially tangible and Q2/Q3 results proved exceptional ad growth and incremental margins.

Edge Autonomy and Golden Dome created a liquid multi-domain platform re-rating, but the stock cleared only local overhead before acquisition financing, equity supply and contract-cost execution broke the earnings bridge.

Philips' CPAP recall created a public, regulator-reinforced share-transfer window that ResMed could address with recovering patient starts and AirSense 11, but component capacity, margin pressure, remediation, and expectation saturation prevented the relative alpha from persisting.
Sea was re-underwritten from a cash-burn and competition casualty into a three-engine platform delivering faster growth, improving segment profit, and ample runway.
A large AI-server guide raise and later S&P 500 inclusion forced a fast re-underwriting of Super Micro's revenue scale and liquidity profile.
A small-cap cancer prior was re-underwritten after ivonescimab produced head-to-head HARMONi-2 evidence against pembrolizumab.
A single-asset clinical re-rating became expectation-saturated before publication and failed when global HARMONi produced strong PFS but non-significant primary OS.
Balance-sheet repair and yen relief lowered left-tail risk, then PS4 and an activist sum-of-the-parts debate made Sony's product-cycle and hidden-asset optionality legible.

A delayed Nvidia ownership disclosure, AI narrative, short interest, and extreme liquidity created a vertical re-rating before margins, losses, and analyst models could support it, producing a genuine breakout that failed by the 42-to-126-day horizons.
A public cost reset, accelerating user growth, improving cash economics, and later pricing power reframed Spotify from spend-heavy streamer to scalable audio platform.
SQM rerated from trough earnings toward an EV-led lithium volume and capacity upcycle, with Atacama ESG de-risking and macro policy support widening the underwriting horizon.
A margin-led steel-cycle recovery acquired outsized alpha when the election pulled infrastructure and trade protection into the valuation before those policies were delivered.

Flood-created HDD scarcity, intact Seagate operations, Samsung scale, a documented margin shock, and aggressive capital return drove a durable relative re-rating before the vertical phase became extended.
Repeated enrollment and revenue estimate resets, capacity expansion, and temporary operating leverage drove TAL beyond China-growth beta until October cost growth broke the extrapolation.

TAN combined broad clean-energy repricing with concentrated solar exposure as resilient constituent economics, rising policy probabilities, and expanding ETF liquidity drove a durable 2020 breakaway that peaked after the original catalyst ladder became widely realized.
Ctrip converted mobile-led volume growth and costly share investment into accelerating revenue, operating leverage, and industry consolidation, creating delayed but very large cohort alpha.
Hospital monetizations, lower leverage, repeated operating upside, USPI mix, and share-count reduction rerated Tenet before policy uncertainty compressed the late-year multiple.
AWS contracting and asset-sale cash turned a newly reorganized merchant generator into a scarce nuclear-and-PJM cash-flow vehicle with a rapidly shrinking share count.
TMDX's regulatory rerating failed in 2021 because FDA de-risking arrived months before a commercial revenue ramp, while the stock and published models had already capitalized that ramp.
Improving pump economics reduced financing risk before Basal-IQ approval and launch expanded Tandem's attainable automated-insulin-delivery franchise.

TSM rerated as leading-edge foundry scarcity became visible through resilient margins, Intel process slippage, 5nm execution, and repeated capacity commitments, although its one-year SOXX-relative alpha faded.

TSM sustained 2025 index alpha as repeated AI/HPC revenue, margin and guidance proof extended the leading-node earnings runway, but only part of the move survived comparison with the semiconductor cohort.
Twilio rerated when renewed double-digit growth combined with operating discipline, free cash flow and a credible multi-year profitability framework.
Unity's elevated Q3 and Weta breakaway failed when flaws in its monetization stack cut Operate growth and forced a major guidance reset.
China reopening and audit-risk relief unlocked a rerating that Vipshop sustained with expanding margins, large repurchases, and a 2023 return to revenue and customer growth.
VK2735 obesity Phase 2 data forced a rapid re-underwriting of Viking from clinical option value to credible GLP-1/GIP scarcity asset.
Vertiv rerated as data-center power and cooling demand translated into revenue growth, margin expansion, and repeated outlook raises.
Vistra's second-leg rerating combined acquired nuclear scale, integrated retail hedging, public nuclear price discovery, rising cash-flow guidance, and continued capital return.

China demand support and supply cuts, U.S. steel trade protection, precious-metals demand, and a post-election infrastructure narrative repriced a deeply compressed, steel-and-miner-heavy ETF far faster than chemical-heavy XLB.
XPeng rerated when MONA M03 and P7+ converted a damaged EV prior into repeated delivery records, improving vehicle margin and a visibly broader product cycle.
Square rerated from a small-merchant payments processor into a broader commerce, lending, and Cash App platform after repeated earnings and product catalysts in 2017.

A newly independent Yum China rerated as margin conversion, digital reach, self-funded growth, and capital return became visible, survived a July quality reset, and gained organic confirmation in October.

Zebra rerated as Motorola Enterprise integration, mix, cost discipline, cash conversion, portfolio focus, and cheaper debt created earnings and deleveraging upside despite stagnant revenue and an intervening accounting restatement.

Backlog-led recovery, large-customer digitization demand and the higher-margin Reflexis workflow-software layer turned Zebra from a pandemic-damaged hardware franchise into an automation-platform rerating, with cash, margins and repeated outlook increases sustaining the break.
